summary.intent: Work through pending todos, implementing SDK CTR encryption for media uploads and debugging BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging, while keeping PRs clean through automated review resolution.
summary.outcome: Delivered two merged PRs: #399 (SDK CTR encryption + centralized encryption mode module) and #400 (BYO vault endpoint + load test fixes + API test mock repairs). A third PR #401 (release gate workflow fix) was opened but not yet merged.

repo: SDK uploadFile() hardcoded GCM encryption — selectEncryptionMode() was only called on the duplicate-file re-encrypt path, never for new uploads. CTR is correct for media files >256KB.

setByoStatus() existed as a service method but had no controller endpoint, making BYO mode untoggleable via API. This was why register-cid always returned 403, not 400 as the todo originally speculated.

The release gate (release-gate.yml) searched only ci-e2e.yml orchestrator runs for desktop E2E results, but successful desktop E2E tests ran as standalone desktop-e2e.yml workflows — the gate never found them.
API test files systematically used jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> with module.get() which loses mock type inference; the fix is to use mock objects directly or cast via as jest.Mocked<T>.

STREAMING_MIME_TYPES was duplicated between packages/sdk/src/client.ts and apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts — both needed FLAC added, prompting centralization into sdk-core/encryption-mode.ts.
pnpm api:generate includes a lint:fix step that was scanning target/ (Rust build artifacts), producing 261 spurious errors; target/** needed adding to eslint.config.js ignores.
The .husky/commit-msg hook is overwritten locally by Entire CLI — should be in .git/info/exclude, not tracked, to prevent showing up in git diffs.
A todo file ended up in both pending/ and done/ after the merge because the PR committed both copies; the pending copy needed manual cleanup after pull.

code.finding: New centralized module: selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size) and normalizeEncryptionMode(mode). Both sdk/client.ts and streaming-crypto.service.ts now import from here.
Added optional encryptionMode param; uses encryptAesCtr + generateCtrIv when 'CTR', falls back to GCM.
uploadFile now calls selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size) and passes result to sdkCore.uploadFile().
Added PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint backed by new SetByoStatusDto and SetByoStatusResponseDto.
createByoClientPool now calls PATCH /vault/byo-status for each account after creation, filters out failed enables, and throws if zero succeed.

ipns-publish was sending {ipnsName, cid} but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires {ipnsName, record, metadataCid}. Fixed by using createAndPublishIpnsRecord from sdk-core. Also hoisted createSdkContext outside the iteration loop.

Old code broke on the first failed run in range without checking if desktop tests actually executed, causing a Phase 35 TEE failure to shadow a successful desktop E2E run. Fix: search desktop-e2e.yml workflow runs directly.
Added target/** to ignores — Rust build artifacts in target/ were producing 261 spurious ESLint errors during pnpm api:generate.

workflow: When orval regenerates the api-client, all files in packages/api-client/src/ must be staged for commit — staging specific files risks leaving new model files and generated directories untracked, failing CI drift checks.
The importOriginal pattern in Vitest mocks (vi.mock with importActual spread) prevents entire-module replacement from dropping new exports, making tests resilient to future export additions.
CodeRabbit and GitHub Copilot reviewers both fire on PRs; resolve-pr-reviews should be run after each new review wave, not just once.
When debugging CI failures, check whether the failing job is the one that matters — a non-desktop job failure in ci-e2e.yml may shadow successful desktop E2E results that ran in a separate workflow.
Entire CLI modifies .husky/commit-msg locally; add it to .git/info/exclude rather than committing the modified hook, which would break commitlint for other contributors.

friction: orval code generation required the API server to be running, and the running server didn't have the new endpoint yet — required a manual rebuild before generating the spec.
GraphQL API for fetching PR review threads timed out repeatedly; had to fall back to REST for fetching and then use GraphQL only for resolving.
The stale pending todo copy (SDK GCM todo) after merge required manual cleanup — both pending/ and done/ copies were committed in the PR.
Background agent for fixing pre-existing API test errors ran in parallel but by the time it completed, the same fixes had already been applied manually, creating duplicate effort.
Nine API spec files had pre-existing typescript errors (jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> pattern) that had to be fixed before typecheck could confirm the new code was clean.
Push commands appeared to hang/not complete during several steps, requiring repeated completion checks.
The accidental apps/api/openapi.json file (created by manual node -e generation script) had to be removed in a follow-up commit after the PR was already open.
open_items: PR #401 (release gate fix to search desktop-e2e.yml directly) was opened but not yet merged — needs review and merge before the next release gate run.
Pending todo: 'Exclude Rust target/ directory from ESLint' was created then immediately fixed inline — the done/ copy exists but the todo tracking is slightly inconsistent.
The no-explicit-any warning in apps/api/src/ipns/delegated-routing.client.spec.ts:60 remains (1 real lint warning after the target/ fix) — suppressed by eslint-disable but not cleaned up.
MigrationStatusDto.completedAt typed as 'object' in api-client — flagged as a Copilot review comment, deferred as a pre-existing Phase 35 issue.
openapi.json missing securitySchemes — Copilot flagged it, marked not applicable, but the spec accuracy could be improved for external consumers.
BYO enable batching for large pools (>50 accounts) — Copilot suggested it, deferred as premature, but worth revisiting if load test pool sizes grow.

Remaining todos: 'Offload large file encryption to Web Worker', 'Add ERC-1271 contract wallet authentication support', 'Research CRDT-based IPNS inbox', 'Make search index build async/incremental', 'Add alternative MFA factor types', 'Investigate removal of mock-ipns-routing layer'.
